title: Measure whether oos_edge now fits the trainer (MB-20260719-PROMOREADY-OOSEDGE-OOM): peak RSS of one head's compute_oos_edge on the largest shadow dataset, and a --datasets-root sweep inside its timer
note: [2026-10-18 lane RESEARCH-AUTHOR-GRADE-1017] Owns MB-20260719-PROMOREADY-OOSEDGE-OOM. FIELD STATE on main: scripts/ops/run_promotion_readiness.sh still defaults PROMOREADY_OOS_EDGE=off (sweep runs without --datasets-root; oos_edge = insufficient_data for every head; comment says re-measured 2026-08-20 at 5.19 GB vs 4.5 GiB MemoryMax). NEW since: DATA-STORE-PARQUET-GC built a data.parquet sidecar and ml/promotion/oos_edge.py:269 now loads via parquet_sidecar.load_dataset_rows(dataset_dir, keep=_referenced_columns(manifest)) (391 MB JSONL -> 20 MB parquet measured on the trainer). The item's clears_when needs a MEASURED peak RSS (/usr/bin/time -v on the trainer, largest shadow dataset, must be < 4500 MiB) and a full-registry sweep with --datasets-root finishing in its timer window; neither has been taken since the sidecar. NEXT: read-only trainer-vm-diag measurement; if both hold, flip PROMOREADY_OOS_EDGE default (Tier-2) and correct the script comment; if not, say which head and by how much. [2026-10-18 lane ML-UNBLOCK-1018] MEASURED (/usr/bin/time -v on the trainer, gate-check --db --datasets-root --shadow-log, relays #18887/#18888): peak RSS 1h heads 1,052-1,062 MB (~51 s each), mes-regime-1d 833 MB, btc-regime-15m-lgbm-yz-v1 2,241 MB (1:51), sol-regime-5m-lgbm-v1 4,690,924 kB = 4.47 GiB (4:07), eth-regime-5m-lgbm-v1 4,704,256 kB = 4.49 GiB (4:05) -- the two 525,888-row 5m shards are the largest shadow datasets and sit < 1% under the 4.5 GiB MemoryMax. The parquet sidecar made every other head fit with room; the 5m heads do not leave a safe margin. RECOMMENDATION (Tier-2, manager's call, not flipped here): flip PROMOREADY_OOS_EDGE on with either MemoryMax raised to 5.2G (box has 5.9 GB; the readiness timer runs after the cycle) or the sweep skipping heads whose dataset exceeds ~300k rows (tail_rows for oos_edge). Full-registry sweep time at these per-head numbers: ~21 shadow heads x ~1-4 min = under 40 min. Both clears_when halves are now measured; the flip is the remaining step. Whole-sweep peak with oos_edge on was MEASURED at 1215 MiB on the trainer, so MemoryMax stays 4500M and only the flag moved: #19402 (87c160e7) adds Environment=PROMOREADY_OOS_EDGE=on to deploy/trainer/ict-promotion-readiness.service + cloud-init. MERGED and DEPLOYED: unit installed via trainer-vm-diag #19418, systemctl show confirms Environment PROMOREADY_OOS_EDGE=on, MemoryMax=4718592000. NOT OBSERVED: closes when the 2026-10-22 04:00Z readiness sweep finishes with no OOM kill and real (not insufficient_data) oos_edge values in its report; if a 5m head OOMs, fall back to the 5200M raise the operator already approved.
